DM.conditional_h_l_reversal: Official Seeed Damiao wiki states reComputer Mini XT30 2+2 H/L are reversed relative to the motor; crossover applies only after those exact endpoints are selected and verified.
DM.ground_reference: Open BOM lists 24 V ground PSU and XT30U female to XT60 male harness; this is not an onboard converter selection or current requirement.

pdu_candidate_endpoint.polarization_key_reference: next to pin 30, per OEM device-side drawing; harness view must not be mirrored implicitly

option_24v.derivation: V_batt_min - V_out > 1.5 V; V_out=24 V => V_batt_min >25.5 V

mips_variants.drawing_issue: Nominal metric 100 mm coexists with 3.935 in (99.949 mm); nonstandard-looking .125-40 callout retained literally. Supplier ICD needed before fitted interface design.

mips_common_boundaries.connector_absence_claim_scope: No connector part number/mate/pin table found in the three inspected public datasheets; does not assert no supplier ICD exists.
